title: introduce-presubmit-guardian-and-dependency-streamliner-refactor-ci-boot
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: Feedback latency and brittle presubmit hooks were slowing down feature development and creating noisy dependency churn. This PR introduces a lightweight Go-based presubmit shim (Presubmit Guardian) to replace several Python orchestration scripts, and a small tool (Dependency Streamliner) that prunes stale dev dependencies and emits a curated lockfile candidate for review. The goal is faster, deterministic presubmit runs and smaller dev-dependency surface for new contributors. Summary of changes: - Add tools/presubmit/guardian: a small Go service used by CI to select staged lint/test lanes, warm cached toolchains, and short-circuit based on file-level changes. Designed to be hermetic and fast to start. - Add tools/dep-streamliner: analyzes package manifests (package.json, go.mod, pyproject.toml), suggests devdep removals, and generates a minimal lockfile patch. - Replace legacy .github presubmit job with a staged presubmit workflow that calls the Guardian service for fast-path checks and only schedules heavyweight integration lanes when necessary. - Release automation: ensure pre-release smoke run signs artifacts and archives a reproducible stamp to GCS; update release script to call the guardian's quiet-window check to avoid collisions. - Repo hygiene: remove dev/Maintain/legacy Makefiles, remove outdated Python2 references in scripts, and normalize CONTRIBUTING.md dev env section. Checklist: - [x] Implement guardian and streamliner prototypes - [x] Wire staged presubmit workflow (.github/workflows/presubmit-staged.yml) - [x] Add unit and integration tests for guardian (go test) - [x] Add dep-streamliner assertion tests and sample outputs - [x] Update CI images to include guardian binary and set a fastpath job - [x] Update docs/ci/upgrade-notes.md - [x] Run dogfood on redwood-examples repo and apply lockfile patches as needed How to review: the PR is split in logical commits (see commits_summary). Focus on the guardian API surface (tools/presubmit/guardian/*.go), staged workflow changes (.github/workflows/presubmit-staged.yml), and dep-streamliner heuristics (tools/dep-streamliner/*). A small migration note is included in docs/ci/upgrade-notes.md. Rollout plan: land behind a feature flag (presubmit.guardian.enabled=false by default), enable for small teams for 48 hours, assess flakiness and time-to-green metrics, then enable org-wide. If the guardian determines a fast-path pass, heavyweight lanes are skipped to reduce CI cost. Related: ENG-1284 (presubmit latency), ENG-1301 (dep hygiene), SUP-3421 (support ticket that surfaced Makefile breakages).
commits_summary: add guardian proto and basic runtime; add streamliner analysis and tests; bump ci images and wire guardian in workflow; remove legacy Makefiles and update docs; add release signing hook and guardian quiet-window; fix test flake from presubmit timeout
ci_checks: Checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass, 1 flaky rerun), integration-smoke (pass), lint (pass), go-vet (pass), release-smoke (pass, signs archived), presubmit-fastpath (pass). One intermittent test (pkg/ci/fastpath_test) required re-run and a small timeout bump was included in a follow-up commit.
review_comments: Liam Chen: Left a couple of nits in guardian/handler.go — prefer context-aware timeouts and avoid global state. Also request small clarifying comment on the fastpath decision tree.
Maya Thompson (author): Addressed the timeouts and added a doc comment explaining the three-tier decision tree. PTAL.
Ravi Patel: Dep-streamliner heuristics look reasonable, but please add a safety net that never removes deps referenced by bindgen/ci scripts. Suggest a unit test covering that case.
Maya Thompson (author): Added the safety-net test and a comment explaining the whitelist. Thanks for the catch.
Sara Gómez: Verified staged workflow on a branch build in org CI; saw 35% reduction in median pre-merge time for small PRs. Approved.
Liam Chen: Approving after fixes — small follow-up suggested to centralize error formatting in guardian for consistent logs.
release_notes:
- Add Presubmit Guardian: a lightweight presubmit coordinator for fast-path checks and staged lint/test lanes.
- Add Dependency Streamliner: tool to surface stale dev deps and propose minimal lockfile updates.
- Staged presubmit workflow: reduces time-to-green for small changes.
- Repo hygiene: remove legacy Makefiles and outdated Python2 references.
- Release automation: ensure artifacts signed during pre-release smoke runs.
testing_instructions: 1) Enable feature flag: PRESUBMIT_GUARDIAN_ENABLED=true in CI image; 2) Run .github/workflows/presubmit-staged.yml against a branch to observe fastpath skip behavior; 3) Use tools/dep-streamliner/local-run --manifest=package.json to generate a lockfile-candidate and review diffs; 4) For release flow, run release/prepare-release.sh --dry-run to validate signing and archive stamp generation.
notes: Follow-up: open a small PR to centralize guardian logging and add a telemetry counter for skipped heavy lanes (ENG-1340). Consider adding a weekly job to run dep-streamliner across repos and post PR suggestions for low-risk removals.
